symbols.read: The bullish read has weakened: the 4H direction flipped back to bearish and the combined 4H+1H signal downgraded from BUY to HOLD, so the prior bullish bias is revised to neutral. Price at 731.35 still holds above the 722.40 lower pivot, but the fresh bull FVGs at 728.12–731.14 that sat beneath price in the prior read are no longer listed — only the older stack at 713.46–719.01 and 720.58–721.80 remains, leaving a thinner cushion under the pivot. The 1H trend is still up and the last bar closed green (729.44→730.60), so this is a stall rather than a reversal; bias is neutral-to-bearish while price stays below 737.02, and a close below 722.40 into the remaining FVG stack revives the bearish case toward 686.36, with 758.44 the upside pivot.
